name: SOICT 2026
full_name: The 15th International Symposium on Information and Communication Technology
summarization: SOICT 2026 is an international symposium covering significant research areas including AI Foundations and Big Data, Networking and Communication Technologies, Multimedia Processing, AI Applications, Generative AI, Applied Operations Research and Optimization, and Cyber Security. The symposium provides an academic forum for researchers and graduate students to share their latest research findings and identify future computer science challenges. Accepted and presented papers will be published in the Springer CCIS series and indexed in major academic databases.

name: RIVF 2026
full_name: RIVF 2026 – The 20th International Conference on Computing and Communication Technologies
summarization: The Research, Innovation and Vision for the Future (RIVF) conference is a major scientific event for researchers, professionals, and students in the field of Computing and Communication Technologies. The 20th edition covers topics including AI foundations, big data, communications, networking, IoT, cybersecurity, software engineering, robotics, and applied operations research. It provides a forum for discussing problems, sharing research results, and establishing academic collaborations.

name: AICON 2026
full_name: 6th EAI International Conference on Artificial Intelligence for Communications and Networks
summarization: The 6th EAI International Conference on Artificial Intelligence for Communications and Networks (EAI AICON 2026) focuses on artificial intelligence methods and systems that directly advance communication technologies, network infrastructures, and connected autonomous systems. It brings together researchers, engineers, and practitioners working at the intersection of AI, communications, and networking to discuss AI-enabled design, optimization, operation, and protection.

name: AMI 2026
full_name: The 1st International Conference on Autonomous Machine Intelligence
summarization: The International Conference on Autonomous Machine Intelligence (AMI 2026) is an international forum dedicated to the study of autonomous, self-supervised, and predictive learning systems. The conference brings together researchers and practitioners to advance the foundations and applications of next-generation intelligent systems capable of learning and acting with minimal human supervision. AMI 2026 focuses on emerging paradigms such as world models, energy-based models, and joint embedding predictive architectures, bridging theoretical advances with practical deployments in real-world environments.

name: ICEBA 2026
full_name: The 12th International Conference on E-Business and Applications
summarization: The International Conference on E-Business and Applications (ICEBA 2026) provides an international forum for presenting original research, exchange, and dissemination of innovative and practical development experiences in e-business and related applications. It draws researchers, application developers, and practitioners from areas such as business intelligence, AIoT-enabled business innovation, business models and processes, ecommerce trading technologies, e-business strategy, digital marketing, information systems, and operations management.

name: REV-ECIT 2026
full_name: Hội nghị Quốc gia lần thứ XXIX về Điện tử, Truyền thông và Công nghệ Thông tin (REV-ECIT 2026)
summarization: The 29th National Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (REV-ECIT 2026) is an annual scientific conference organized by the Radio and Electronics Association of Vietnam (REV). The conference covers topics across electronics, communications, and information technology, with a particular focus on national strategic technologies.
location: Cục Tần số Vô tuyến điện, Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ, số 115 Trần Duy Hưng, phường Yên Hòa, TP. Hà Nội

name: AICI 2027
full_name: The Eighth International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computational Intelligence
summarization: The International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computational Intelligence aims to bring together researchers working on artificial intelligence, computational intelligence, and related topics. The event provides an opportunity to present and discuss theoretical and applied research problems while fostering research collaborations across fields such as fuzzy systems, machine learning, deep learning, and soft computing.
location: Thang Long University, Nghiem Xuan Yem Road, Dinh Cong District, Hanoi

name: ICIIT 2027
full_name: 2027 12th International Conference on Intelligent Information Technology
summarization: The 12th International Conference on Intelligent Information Technology (ICIIT 2027) aims to gather professors, researchers, scholars, and industrial pioneers from all over the world. It serves as a premier forum for the presentation and exchange of past experiences, new advances, and research results in the field of theoretical and industrial intelligent information technology and related areas.

name: ICCIES 2027
full_name: The 3rd International Conference on Computational Intelligence in Engineering Science
summarization: ICCIES 2027 is an annual international academic forum that provides a platform for researchers, academics, and professionals to exchange knowledge, share experiences, and explore innovations, recent advances, and emerging trends in intelligent computing across a broad range of engineering disciplines, including Information Technology, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, and the Internet of Things ecosystem.
location: Ton Duc Thang University, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

name: AAMAS 2027
full_name: The 26th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems
summarization: AAMAS 2027 is the flagship conference of the International Foundation for Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (IFAAMAS), bringing together researchers and practitioners in all areas of agent and agentic technology. It provides an internationally renowned high-profile forum for publishing and discovering the latest developments in autonomous agents and multiagent systems.

full_name: The 25th ACM International Conference on Mobile Systems, Applications, and Services
summarization: ACM MobiSys 2027 aims to showcase innovative and impactful research on the design, implementation, usage, and evaluation of mobile computing and wireless systems, applications, and services. The conference brings together researchers and practitioners to present high-impact technical contributions, investigate emerging mobile use cases, and discuss real-world system deployments. It is sponsored by ACM SIGMOBILE.
location: The Reverie Saigon, Times Square Building, Ho Chi Minh City

name: EASE 2027
full_name: International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering
summarization: EASE is an internationally leading venue for academics and practitioners to present and discuss their research on evidence-based software engineering and its implications for software practice. The 31st edition of EASE will take place in Hanoi, Vietnam, welcoming high-quality submissions across various tracks including research papers, short papers, industry papers, and workshops.
location: Hanoi University of Science and Technology and the PAN Pacific Hotel, Hanoi

name: WCST 2026
full_name: 4th World Conference on Smart Tourism
summarization: The 4th World Conference on Smart Tourism (WCST) invites researchers, practitioners, policymakers, and industry experts to submit their work for this premier event dedicated to advancing smart tourism. This year’s theme highlights the vital role of academia–industry collaboration in harnessing Artificial Intelligence to drive transformative innovation in tourism and hospitality across the Global South.

name: TSE 2026
full_name: 2026 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Search & Rescue and Emergency Response Systems
summarization: The 2026 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Search & Rescue and Emergency Response Systems (TSE 2026) provides a forum for exchanging ideas, discussing research results, and presenting cutting-edge innovations at the intersection of science, technology, and emergency management. The conference brings together researchers, engineers, practitioners, policymakers, and industry leaders to address the increasingly complex challenges of search and rescue operations and emergency response in the modern era.

name: ICTA 2026
full_name: International Conference on Advances in Information and Communication Technology
summarization: The International Conference on Advances in Information and Communication Technology (ICTA 2026) aims to provide an international forum for researchers, academics, industry experts, and practitioners to exchange innovative ideas, research findings, and practical experiences in the field of Information and Communication Technology. The conference focuses on the rapid convergence of Artificial Intelligence, advanced ICT infrastructure, and cybersecurity technologies transforming modern societies, smart cities, and digital industries.
location: Hai Phong University, No 171, Phan Dang Luu St, Phu Lien, Hai Phong

name: ICDSAIA 2026
full_name: International Conference on Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Applications
summarization: The International Conference on Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Applications (ICDSAIA 2026) is the second edition jointly organized by the University of Salford and East Asia University of Technology, taking place in Hanoi, Vietnam. The conference provides a premier forum for researchers, practitioners, and industry leaders to exchange ideas, address challenges, and share advances in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and their real-world applications.

name: AIEI 2027
full_name: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Energy and Infrastructure
summarization: AIEI 2027 is the second edition of the international conference series dedicated to artificial intelligence for energy systems, resilient infrastructure, and sustainable cities. Hosted by COSARI at Van Lang University, the event brings together researchers, academics, engineers, and students to share recent findings and discuss responsible AI solutions across various tracks including smart energy, infrastructure, trustworthy AI, and reliability.
location: Van Lang University Main Campus, Ho Chi Minh City

name: IEEE SMC 2027
full_name: 2027 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics
summarization: The IEEE SMC 2027 is the flagship annual conference of the IEEE SMC Society, focusing on systems science, cybernetics, and human-machine systems. Under the theme “Human-Centric Intelligence: Shaping the Digital Future”, it brings together global researchers and industry experts to present novel theory, experimental validations, and applications. Accepted papers will be submitted for inclusion in the IEEE Xplore Digital Library and indexed in major databases.
location: Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera Hotel, Ho Chi Minh City

name: FJCAI 2027
full_name: Hội thảo khoa học về Trí tuệ nhân tạo FJCAI 2027
summarization: FJCAI 2027 is an annual national academic forum on Artificial Intelligence, bringing together researchers, lecturers, graduate students, undergraduates, and experts in AI. The conference focuses on exchanging and sharing the latest research results, development trends, challenges, and applications of AI across various fields such as Machine Learning & Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing & Vietnamese language, Computer Vision & Multimodal data, Generative AI & LLMs, and AI Applications.
location: Trường Đại học Công nghệ Thông tin và Truyền thông Việt - Hàn (VKU), Quận Ngũ Hành Sơn, TP. Đà Nẵng

name: IEEE NICE–TEAS ASIA 2026
full_name: 4th IEEE Networking International Conference on Emerging Trends in Expert Systems, Applications & Security, ASIA
summarization: The 4th IEEE Networking International Conference on Emerging Trends in Expert Systems, Applications & Security, ASIA (IEEE NICE-TEAS ASIA 2026) focuses on networking, expert systems, applications, and security. Accepted papers will be submitted for possible inclusion in IEEE Xplore. The event gathers participants from over 20 countries in Hanoi, Vietnam.

name: GCHRCLI 2027
full_name: Global Conference on Human Rights, Cybersecurity & Legal Innovation
summarization: The Global Conference on Human Rights, Cybersecurity & Legal Innovation (GCHRCLI-2027) provides an international platform for academicians, researchers, engineers, and students to share research findings and experiences with global experts. It aims to foster international linkage and collaboration in human rights, cybersecurity, and legal innovation.

name: ICCSS 2027
full_name: 2027 10th International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Simulation
summarization: The 10th International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Simulation (ICCSS 2027) brings together scientists, engineers, technicians, and graduate students to share research experiences and ideas in circuits, systems, and simulation through oral and poster presentations. Sponsored by Duy Tan University, the event offers a platform to exchange updated research knowledge and publish findings in the conference proceedings.

name: ICERA 2026
full_name: International Conference on Engineering Research and Applications
summarization: The 9th International Conference on Engineering Research and Applications (ICERA 2026) is an international forum to disseminate information on the most recent and relevant researches, theories, and practices in engineering research, applications, and economics. It covers tracks in mechanical engineering, materials and mechanics of materials, mechatronics and micro mechatronics, automotive engineering, electrical and electronics engineering, information and communication technology, and economics.
location: Thai Nguyen University of Technology, Thai Nguyen Province

name: 3RD EAI RAIDS 2027
full_name: The 3rd EAI International Conference on Responsible Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
summarization: The 3rd EAI International Conference on Responsible Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (EAI RAIDS 2027) serves as an international forum for the exchange of research and ideas regarding Responsible & Trustworthy AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, AI applications, transparency, fairness, privacy, and related emerging technologies.

name: ICETAI 2027
full_name: International Conference on Educational Technology and Artificial Intelligence
summarization: ICETAI 2027 focuses on trustworthy agentic AI in education, exploring the shift from single-prompt tools to agentic learning partners. Key areas include multi-agent systems, explainable AI for learning, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent tutoring systems, and ethical considerations in educational AI.

name: EAI INISCOM 2027
full_name: 13th EAI International Conference on Industrial Networks and Intelligent Systems
summarization: The 13th EAI International Conference on Industrial Networks and Intelligent Systems (EAI INISCOM 2027) explores the frontier of the 6G era, focusing on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Twins, and Quantum Computing, and their transition from cutting-edge technologies to real-world applications. It invites original, unpublished research papers, including visionary, experimental, systems-oriented, and work-in-progress contributions. The event brings together researchers, practitioners, and industry experts to advance the state of the art in intelligent systems and industrial networks.
location: Duy Tan University, 3 Quang Trung St., Hai Chau Dist., Da Nang City

name: GSETS 2027
full_name: The 3rd International Conference on "Green Solutions and Emerging Technologies for Sustainability"
summarization: GSETS 2027 is an international scientific event showcasing advanced achievements in Material Science, Green Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and emerging technologies aimed at achieving the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The conference focuses on specialized topics including Advanced Materials and Green Manufacturing, Solutions and Technologies for Sustainable Development, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development, and Health Sciences for Sustainable Development.
location: HUTECH University (Thu Duc Campus), Ho Chi Minh City

name: ICBDCSI 2026
full_name: International Conference on Big Data Computer Science and Information
summarization: The International Conference on Big Data Computer Science and Information aims to bring together leading academic scientists, researchers and research scholars to exchange and share their experiences and research results on all aspects of Big Data Computer Science and Information. It also provides a premier interdisciplinary platform for researchers, practitioners and educators to present and discuss the most recent innovations, trends, and concerns as well as practical challenges encountered and solutions adopted in the fields of Big Data Computer Science and Information.

name: ICISN 2027
full_name: International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Networks
summarization: The International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Networks (ICISN 2027) focuses on intelligent systems, network applications, and latest technological advancements within computer science and information technology. It provides an international technical forum for experts from industry, government, and academia to present research results and address new challenges in intelligent networks, multi-generational mobility, and connected systems.
location: University of Hai Duong (UHD), Hai Duong

name: SIMC 2026
full_name: The 2nd International Conference on Semantic Intelligence in Massive Computing
summarization: The International Conference on Semantic Intelligence in Massive Computing (SIMC 2027) brings together researchers, practitioners, and industry experts to explore the latest advances in semantic intelligence and its applications in massive computing environments like cloud, edge-fog architectures, and IoT. The conference aims to foster interdisciplinary collaboration and discuss emerging trends in semantic modeling, knowledge representation, reasoning, and artificial intelligence. Accepted papers will be published in the Lecture Notes in Electrical Engineering (LNEE) series by Springer and indexed in Scopus.
location: Ho Chi Minh City University of Banking (HUB), No. 36 Ton That Dam Street, Ho Chi Minh City

name: VNNIC Internet Conference 2026
full_name: VNNIC Internet Conference 2026
summarization: VNNIC Internet Conference 2026 focuses on accelerating IPv6 transition and moving towards IPv6-only environments, bringing together policymakers, network operators, researchers, and technology experts. The conference aims to guide the technical community in deploying, operating, and optimizing IPv6-enabled and IPv6-only networks while promoting next-generation Internet infrastructure and digital transformation.
location: Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera, 88 Dong Khoi Street, Ho Chi Minh City
